timeline.body: On November 8, 2026, between 08:43 and 12:29 UTC, unauthenticated requests to github.com and the GitHub REST API experienced elevated error rates. During this period, 11.3% of unauthenticated requests and 46.1% of release asset download requests failed. Authenticated requests were largely unaffected. Initial errors occurred in a backend service handling unauthenticated web traffic. A subsequent traffic spike caused high CPU utilization on servers in our caching layer. Some servers remained unhealthy after the spike ended, prolonging the disruption. We restored service by restarting caching software and rebooting affected servers.
